svg.title: SEDNA / Graphic language
svg.desc: SEDNA — Explore the Unseen. Visual identity, November 14, 2026.

g.aria-label: Use thin lines, wide intervals, and a single highlighted position to carry the visual identity into covers,
In a presentation, a short pause before revealing the name can evoke the moment of discovery. The kit
provides static artwork for that sequence.
In the viewer, preserve the appearance of the data and cut directly between observation epochs.
